Course ID 001084 Offer Nbr 1 Career Undergraduate UG Dates 2026/8/1 - 2026/12/31 Grading Graded GRD Campus Main Campus MAIN Meeting Information Days & Times Room Instructor Meeting Dates Mo 15:30 - 18:15 Yasumoto Int'l Acad Park LT8 Professor KANG Ya 9/7, 9/14, 9/21, 9/28, 10/5, 10/12 Mo 15:30 - 18:15 Yasumoto Int'l Acad Park LT8 Professor KANG Ya 10/26, 11/2, 11/9, 11/16, 11/23, 11/30 Enrollment Information For UG PACC Major Pre-requisite: ACCT1111 or ACCT2111 Enrollment Requirements Class Attributes English only Class Availability Class Capacity 60 Wait List Capacity 999 Enrollment Total 55 Wait List Total 0 Available Seats 5 Description This course is designed to provide students with the concepts and techniques of managerial accounting, with the emphasis on the uses of management accounting information by managers in planning, controlling and decisions making. Major topics will include costing systems, activity-based costing, cost-volume-profit relationship, variable costing, budgeting, standard costing, and relevant costs for decision-making.
